entries.title: John 10:1
segments: Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that entereth not by the door into the fold of the sheep, but climbeth up some other way, the same is a thief and a robber.

entries.title: John 10:2
segments: But he that entereth in by the door is the shepherd of the sheep.

entries.title: John 10:3
segments: To him the porter openeth; and the sheep hear his voice: and he calleth his own sheep by name, and leadeth them out.

entries.title: John 10:4
segments: When he hath put forth all his own, he goeth before them, and the sheep follow him: for they know his voice.

entries.title: John 10:5
segments: And a stranger will they not follow, but will flee from him: for they know not the voice of strangers.

entries.title: John 10:6
segments: This parable spake Jesus unto them: but they understood not what things they were which he spake unto them.

entries.title: John 10:7
segments: Jesus therefore said unto them again, Verily, verily, I say unto you, I am the door of the sheep.

entries.title: John 10:8
segments: All that came before me are thieves and robbers: but the sheep did not hear them.

entries.title: John 10:9
segments: I am the door; by me if any man enter in, he shall be saved, and shall go in and go out, and shall find pasture.

entries.title: John 10:10
segments: The thief cometh not, but that he may steal, and kill, and destroy: I came that they may have life, and may have [it] abundantly.

entries.title: John 10:11
segments: I am the good shepherd: the good shepherd layeth down his life for the sheep.

entries.title: John 10:12
segments: He that is a hireling, and not a shepherd, whose own the sheep are not, beholdeth the wolf coming, and leaveth the sheep, and fleeth, and the wolf snatcheth them, and scattereth [them]:

entries.title: John 10:13
segments: [he fleeth] because he is a hireling, and careth not for the sheep.

entries.title: John 10:14
segments: I am the good shepherd; and I know mine own, and mine own know me,

entries.title: John 10:15
segments: even as the Father knoweth me, and I know the Father; and I lay down my life for the sheep.

entries.title: John 10:16
segments: And other sheep I have, which are not of this fold: them also I must bring, and they shall hear my voice: and they shall become one flock, one shepherd.

entries.title: John 10:17
segments: Therefore doth the Father love me, because I lay down my life, that I may take it again.

entries.title: John 10:18
segments: No one taketh it away from me, but I lay it down of myself. I have power to lay it down, and I have power to take it again. This commandment received I from my Father.

entries.title: John 10:19
segments: There arose a division again among the Jews because of these words.

entries.title: John 10:20
segments: And many of them said, He hath a demon, and is mad; why hear ye him?

entries.title: John 10:21
segments: Others said, These are not the sayings of one possessed with a demon. Can a demon open the eyes of the blind?

entries.title: John 10:22
segments: And it was the feast of the dedication at Jerusalem:

entries.title: John 10:23
segments: it was winter; and Jesus was walking in the temple in Solomon's porch.

entries.title: John 10:24
segments: The Jews therefore came round about him, and said unto him, How long dost thou hold us in suspense? If thou art the Christ, tell us plainly.

entries.title: John 10:25
segments: Jesus answered them, I told you, and ye believe not: the works that I do in my Father's name, these bear witness of me.

entries.title: John 10:26
segments: But ye believe not, because ye are not of my sheep.

entries.title: John 10:27
segments: My sheep hear my voice, and I know them, and they follow me:

entries.title: John 10:28
segments: and I give unto them eternal life; and they shall never perish, and no one shall snatch them out of my hand.

entries.title: John 10:29
segments: My Father, who hath given [them] unto me, is greater than all; and no one is able to snatch [them] out of the Father's hand.

entries.title: John 10:30
segments: I and the Father are one.

entries.title: John 10:31
segments: The Jews took up stones again to stone him.

entries.title: John 10:32
segments: Jesus answered them, Many good works have I showed you from the Father; for which of those works do ye stone me?

entries.title: John 10:33
segments: The Jews answered him, For a good work we stone thee not, but for blasphemy; and because that thou, being a man, makest thyself God.

entries.title: John 10:34
segments: Jesus answered them, Is it not written in your law, I said, ye are gods?

entries.title: John 10:35
segments: If he called them gods, unto whom the word of God came (and the scripture cannot be broken),

entries.title: John 10:36
segments: say ye of him, whom the Father sanctified and sent into the world, Thou blasphemest; because I said, I am [the] Son of God?

entries.title: John 10:37
segments: If I do not the works of my Father, believe me not.

entries.title: John 10:38
segments: But if I do them, though ye believe not me, believe the works: that ye may know and understand that the Father is in me, and I in the Father.

entries.title: John 10:39
segments: They sought again to take him: and he went forth out of their hand.

entries.title: John 10:40
segments: And he went away again beyond the Jordan into the place where John was at the first baptizing; and there be abode.

entries.title: John 10:41
segments: And many came unto him; and they said, John indeed did no sign: but all things whatsoever John spake of this man were true.

entries.title: John 10:42
segments: And many believed on him there.
